Game Overview

Perimeter - Legate Edition is a strategy game built around command the Exodus civilization in a groundbreaking RTS where strategic terraforming reshapes battlefields. Build defensive perimeters and seize territories in a dynamic, evolving environment. Adapt, survive, and lead your people to victory in a world where earth's future rests in your hands.
